# Nyumbani Concierge

> Trusted back-home concierge for Kenyans living abroad. You're abroad, I'm back home — consider it handled.

Nyumbani Concierge helps Kenyans in the diaspora (USA, UK, Canada, UAE, Australia and beyond) get things done in Kenya with photo/video proof and official receipts. Create a free account, order a service, pay by M-Pesa (STK push) or bank transfer, and receive the report in your account.

## Services (fixed prices in KES)

- **Document pickup & delivery** — KES 1,500 per job. Certificates, KRA PIN, police clearance, NTSA (+ official fees with receipts).
- **Bulk / urgent document run** — KES 3,000 per run. 3+ documents or same-day priority processing.
- **School fee payment + receipts** — KES 500 per payment. Pay fees for family and send the official receipt each time.
- **Business registration (company, sole prop)** — KES 5,000. eCitizen/BRS filings, KRA PIN, permits.
- **Land & title verification** — title/ownership search from KES 5,000, site visit with same-day video report from KES 3,000, full package with lawyer sign-off KES 15,000.
- **Home-care retainer** — KES 3,000/month. Bills, plot rent, school fees, family support — with receipts every time.

## Payment

- **M-Pesa** via secure STK push (works from abroad — M-Pesa Global, Sendwave, WorldRemit, Wise).
- **Bank transfer** for larger or international payments.
- Instant receipt with a transaction ID after every payment.

## How it works

1. Create a free account (Login / Sign up).
2. Order from the catalog or make a custom request.
3. Pay with M-Pesa or bank transfer.
4. Follow the job on WhatsApp; the full report (photos, video, documents, receipts) is posted in My Reports.

## Safety

Registered business (reg number + KRA PIN shown on the Contact page). Every job ends with an official receipt carrying your transaction ID. Purchase money for land deals goes to a lawyer/escrow — never through the concierge.
